title: MacOmarchy settings
description: Runtime settings for the Hammerspoon tiling, desktop, focus and clipboard modules. Defaults live in settings.default.json; the user file stores only changed values.

ui.title: General
ui.description: Application-wide notifications. The tiling exclude list remains local state.

alerts.title: Show notifications
alerts.description: Show Hammerspoon alerts for layout, desktop, clipboard and window actions.

alertDuration.title: Notification duration
alertDuration.description: How long a notification stays on screen, in seconds.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Keyboard shortcuts owned by MacOmarchy. Pick a group to narrow the list, then click a shortcut and press the new combination; use Disable to turn one off (None). Native macOS shortcuts (Mission Control, Spotlight, input sources) stay in System Settings. Desktop and move-window entries above desktops.maxNumber are inactive until a reload.

layout_next.title: Layout — next
layout_next.description: Switch to the next layout in the enabled list.

layout_previous.title: Layout — previous
layout_previous.description: Switch to the previous layout in the enabled list.

layout_single.title: Layout — single window
layout_single.description: Fill the screen with the focused window.

window_toggle_floating.title: Window — toggle floating
window_toggle_floating.description: Pin or unpin the focused window from the tiling layout.

tiling_toggle.title: Tiling — enable / disable
tiling_toggle.description: Turn automatic tiling on or off.

window_swap_previous.title: Window — swap with previous
window_swap_previous.description: Swap the focused window with the previous tile.

window_swap_next.title: Window — swap with next
window_swap_next.description: Swap the focused window with the next tile.

window_previous_monitor.title: Window — previous display
window_previous_monitor.description: Move the focused window to the previous display.

window_next_monitor.title: Window — next display
window_next_monitor.description: Move the focused window to the next display.

window_swap_main.title: Window — swap with main
window_swap_main.description: Swap the focused window with the main pane.

focus_left.title: Focus — left
focus_left.description: Focus the nearest window to the left.

focus_right.title: Focus — right
focus_right.description: Focus the nearest window to the right.

app_exclude.title: App — exclude from tiling
app_exclude.description: Keep the focused app out of automatic tiling.

desktop_1.title: Desktop — 1
desktop_1.description: Switch to Desktop 1 on the display under the pointer.

desktop_2.title: Desktop — 2
desktop_2.description: Switch to Desktop 2 on the display under the pointer.

window_move_1.description: Move the focused window to Desktop 1, creating it if needed.

window_move_9.description: Move the focused window to Desktop 9, creating it if needed.

menu_commands_alt.title: Commands — menu (alternate)
menu_commands_alt.description: Alternate key for the command palette.

tiler.title: Tiling
tiler.description: Automatic tiling, window geometry, new-window placement, the layout cycle and retry behaviour. The Excluded apps tab lists apps that stay out of the layout; built-in exclusions are always kept, while remembered exclusions can be included again.

enabled.title: Automatic tiling
enabled.description: Arrange standard windows automatically. Turning it off leaves every window where it is until it is enabled again.

gap.title: Gap between windows
gap.description: Space between adjacent tiled windows, in pixels.

margin.title: Outer margin
margin.description: Space kept between the working area edge and the tiled windows, in pixels.

tolerance.title: Geometry tolerance
tolerance.description: How many pixels a window may differ from its target before it is moved again. Raise it for apps with rounded or constrained frames.

newWindowPosition.title: New window position
newWindowPosition.description: Where a newly tiled window joins the order. Front makes it the main pane; end appends it after the existing windows.

layout.title: Default layout
layout.description: Layout used for a desktop that has not been arranged yet.

ratio.title: Main pane ratio
ratio.description: Share of the working area given to the main pane in Tall and Wide layouts.

ratioMin.title: Smallest main pane
ratioMin.description: Lower bound for the main pane ratio when shrinking with the keyboard.

ratioMax.title: Largest main pane
ratioMax.description: Upper bound for the main pane ratio when expanding with the keyboard.

resizeStep.title: Resize step
resizeStep.description: How much one shrink or expand key press changes the main pane ratio.

debounce.title: Reflow debounce
debounce.description: Quiet period that merges a burst of window events into one tiling pass, in seconds.

maxAttempts.title: Resize attempts
maxAttempts.description: How many times a window that rejects its target size is asked again before the next event or a reflow.

fallbackScan.title: Fallback scan interval
fallbackScan.description: Period of the safety scan that catches missed window notifications, in seconds.

layouts.title: Layout cycle
layouts.description: Order used by the next and previous layout commands.

desktops.title: Desktops
desktops.description: Native Space navigation, creation, polling and scroll gesture timing.

settleDelay.title: Transition settle time
settleDelay.description: Quiet period after a desktop change before tiling resumes, in seconds.

scrollLock.title: Scroll gesture lock
scrollLock.description: How long one Cmd+scroll notch is allowed to switch a desktop before the next one counts, in seconds.

transitionTimeout.title: Transition timeout
transitionTimeout.description: How long a desktop switch or window move may take before it is reported as failed, in seconds.

creationTimeout.title: Creation timeout
creationTimeout.description: How long Mission Control may take to create one desktop before the operation is abandoned, in seconds.

pollInterval.title: Transition poll interval
pollInterval.description: How often the active desktop is checked while a switch or window move runs, in seconds. Lower is smoother but uses more CPU.

checkInterval.title: Verification interval
checkInterval.description: How often window membership and Mission Control results are verified, in seconds.

focusDelay.title: Focus handoff delay
focusDelay.description: Pause after a desktop switch before focusing a window on the new desktop, in seconds.

maxNumber.title: Highest desktop number
maxNumber.description: Largest desktop number accepted by a window move. The command menu is rebuilt on the next Hammerspoon reload.

focus.title: Focus follows pointer
focus.description: Hover timing and text-field behaviour for focusing the window under the pointer.

enabled.title: Focus follows pointer
enabled.description: Focus the window under the resting pointer. The choice is mirrored to focus-follows-mouse.txt for older configurations.

delay.title: Hover delay
delay.description: How long the pointer must rest on a window before it is focused, in seconds.

slop.title: Movement threshold
slop.description: Pointer movement that counts as leaving the resting position, in pixels.

clickTextFields.title: Click text fields when needed
clickTextFields.description: If the accessibility focus request does not move the caret, click the text field under the pointer once. Disable to avoid synthetic clicks.

fieldRetryDelay.title: Text field retry delay
fieldRetryDelay.description: Wait before checking the text field again after focusing its window, in seconds.

clipboard.title: Clipboard history
clipboard.description: How much text and image history is kept, and how the chooser behaves.

maxItems.title: History size
maxItems.description: Number of clipboard entries kept before the oldest is dropped.

maxImageMB.title: Largest archived image
maxImageMB.description: Images larger than this stay on the system clipboard and are not archived, in megabytes.

storeImages.title: Archive images
storeImages.description: Copy images into the clipboard history. Disable to keep text entries only; existing image entries stay until they age out.

previewSize.title: Thumbnail size
previewSize.description: Longest edge of newly archived preview images in the clipboard chooser, in pixels.

pollInterval.title: Pasteboard poll interval
pollInterval.description: How often the clipboard change counter is checked, in seconds. Lower is more responsive but uses more CPU.

saveDelay.title: History save delay
saveDelay.description: Quiet period before the history file is written, in seconds.

chooserRows.title: Chooser rows
chooserRows.description: Number of clipboard entries visible at once in the chooser.

pasteDelay.title: Paste delay
pasteDelay.description: Pause after restoring an entry before sending Cmd+V, in seconds.
